text:
olivia: Quick sync — we need marketplace + sandbox creds for the next LangChain/LlamaIndex demo. Target handoff Tue AM. Can the partner success checklist + demo creds template be finalized today?

jess: I can own the checklist. Is there a canonical demo creds format we use for SI partners?

olivia: Not officially. We've done ad hoc: google drive doc + one-time tokens. Want to standardize. cc @sam for technical token format and rotation policy.

sam: For sandbox access we usually issue short-lived API keys + role-limited service accounts. Prefer JWTs via our temp-creds service. Example payload:

```
{
  "exp": 1680000000,
  "scope": ["generate", "embeddings"],
  "project": "partner-sandbox"
}
```

sam: We can add IP restrictions for the partner demo if needed.

mike: For sales demos we need a stable demo dataset + SSO disabled. Also need a billing flag to prevent cost spikes. Can we create a demo quota of 100k tokens?

jess: 100k sounds good. I'll add quota to checklist.

olivia: Legal needs an asset attestation before we hand over keys — quick signoff from partnerships and security. @integrations-bot can you create a JIRA ticket?

integrations-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-4821 — "LangChain sandbox creds + demo asset attestation". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNER-4821

sam: I'll prep the rotation script and a sample token with 7-day TTL. Pushing patch to infra repo.

mike: Also want a short runbook for the demo: how to swap in production models, and how to fail to a lower-cost quantized variant if latency spikes.

jess: I'll draft the runbook and checklist, then drop in the drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/partners/langchain-demo

olivia: Awesome. Action items: jess checklist + runbook, sam rotation script + sample token, mike demo quota + dataset snapshot, olivia will coordinate legal signoff. Try to finish by EOD today. :thumbsup: 

sam: noted, will PR by 5pm.

jess: will share checklist by 4pm.

mike: dataset snapshot uploaded by 3pm.

olivia: Thanks team — tagging followups in PARTNER-4821. :rocket:
